race.description: Become A Brc Member Mdn Plate
race.comment: THREEEYEDWITCH (14) is unlucky to still be a maiden hitting the top-four in all four outings to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble and should be right there when the whips are cracking. SORRENTI (11) has hit the frame in all three starts and will strip fitter second-up from the break. Looms as the main danger. The well-related LIPIZZANER (5) (half to G2 winner First Settler) placed around this circuit last time out and gets a jockey upgrade in form of Thompson in the irons. Top-three aspirations. BEAT THE RAP (2) maps ideally for this from gate two and looks a must for the exotics players. INDAMOUSE (4) next in line in a race with only a handful of chances.
